list.description: Find a student by name, admission number, class and section, or a parent's name.

detail.mappingDescription: Suggestions come from the column headings. Check each one, then check the rows.

detail.memoBody: A printable memo to file with the paper admission register.

classes.addDescription: Add a class with its name.
classes.defaultsBody: This adds any missing classes from Nursery to Class XII. Classes you already have stay as they are.

form.hint: Write up to 1000 characters. Do not type Aadhaar numbers.

memory.addHint: For example: I teach Class 7 mathematics and prefer short answers. Up to 200 characters.

hero.note: For staff of schools that use SchoolOS.

certificates.body: Printable certificates and registers in your school's familiar formats. This is the next module we are building.

ask.body: Ask in plain English. Answers come from your school's own records and documents and show their sources, or say that nothing was found in the school records.

registers.description: Print the registers in their familiar A4 format to keep the paper registers complete.

circulars.noticeDescription: Draft a short notice from this circular. Only the circular's text is used, never student records.

notices.description: Short notices for your parents' groups. Staff edit them and an approver approves them; SchoolOS never sends them itself.

new.description: Write what parents need to know; AI drafts the notice. Or start empty.

editor.incomplete: Fill in the title and the notice before approving.

settings.description: Date format, sign-out time and AI features.
